text:
incident-bot: Pager — reserved pool 'reserved-east-us-2' showing sustained saturation. GPUs at 99% for 12m, queue length >500, autoscaler failed to add nodes (scale_error=quota_exceeded). Severity P1 :rotating_light:

sam.oncall: I'm on it. pinging @maya.sre and @josh.runtime. Any immediate customer impact known?

maya.sre: Seeing a bunch of 429/503s in the dedicated route for reserved pools. Graphs: latency spike and token queues backlogged. Likely noisy tenant in reservation.

josh.runtime: Confirmed autoscaler logs show attempts to scale to +8 workers but provider API returning 403 quota_limit_reached. Also hit our per-pool max_scale=50.

ops-bot: Recent actions: autoscaler attempted 3 launches at 2145520025, 2145520060, 2145520120 — all failed with error: "quota exceeded for GPUs in us-east-2".

nora.infra: Quick check — cloud quota for GPUs for our account is 48 in us-east-2, current usage (hosted + dedicated + reserved bursts) = 49. Looks like a recent hosted spike pushed us over.

emily.acc: Heads-up — customer 'BrightLeaf Retail' is on this reserved pool. I just got an inbound support note: jobs timing out and failing to complete. They're on a scheduled marketing push right now.

liam.support: Ticket #INC-9981 opened by BrightLeaf: "Model generation failing, 503s, urgent". Customer severity = high. We're in a page with them in the meantime.

vlad.ml: From logs, one tenant (brightleaf-batch) is doing long synchronous batch runs using large sequence lengths. Their tasks are holding GPUs for 10-20 minutes each, killing throughput. Looks noisy.

sam.oncall: OK, mitigation plan: 1) temporary soft-evict of low-priority scheduled jobs, 2) try to borrow burst capacity from 'burst-pool-us' (if allowed), 3) rate-limit noisy tenant within reserved pool. Assigning tasks: @nora.infra try to request emergency quota increase or enable cross-region burst. @josh.runtime and @maya.sre do the eviction + policy change. @emily.acc keep BrightLeaf updated.

josh.runtime: I can trigger eviction and priority rebalancing. Proposed command to evict non-enterprise low-priority jobs from reserved-east-us-2: ```
redwoodctl pool reassign --from reserved-east-us-2 --to shared-burst-us --filter "priority<50" --dry-run
```

maya.sre: After dry-run looks safe. I'll execute live with a short maintenance window. Will stagger to avoid thundering herd.

nora.infra: Quota request submitted to cloud provider via console ticket #Q-4523. ETA unknown. Meanwhile I'll try to provision a small bypass via partner region us-east-1 as a hotfix.

ops-bot: Policy change ready: per-tenant concurrent limit can be lowered with: ```
redwoodctl tenant update brightleaf-batch --concurrency 8 --priority 80
```

sam.oncall: Apply limit to brightleaf-batch for now. We want to preserve their SLA but throttle their batch concurrency to free slots for others. @josh.runtime please note rollback plan.

josh.runtime: Applied limit at 2145520145. Monitoring queue.

incident-bot: Event: tenant throttle applied (tenant=brightleaf-batch, concurrency=8) at 2145520145.

maya.sre: Starting evictions of completed/queued low-priority jobs (staged batches) now. Expect 10% immediate reduction in queue.

liam.support: Update to BrightLeaf: "We're throttling large batch jobs to restore capacity; small interactive requests should resume within ~5-10 minutes. We're actively scaling/reserving extra capacity."

emily.acc: BrightLeaf acknowledged, appreciates the quick response but asked for an ETA to full restoration. I told them we'll confirm in 15m.

vlad.ml: Noting downstream risk: if we evict too many of BrightLeaf's batches, their pipeline SLA could miss daily windows. Need to coordinate with account team before full eviction.

sam.oncall: Agreed — keep partial throttle rather than full eviction. Priority is to restore interactive traffic and avoid cross-tenant failures.

josh.runtime: Short-term hotfix: migrate small set of BrightLeaf's longest-running jobs to a preemptible burst queue where possible: ```
redwoodctl job migrate --job-id <job> --target burst-preemptible --preemptible-flag true
``` This will free reserved GPUs quickly.

nora.infra: I was able to bring up 4 GPUs in us-east-1 as a cross-region burst at 2145520300. Cloud shows them as available to the cluster. Autoscaler still blocked for us-east-2 but cross-region routing permitted by smart-routing policy.

ops-bot: Routing change executed: prefer burst-us-east-1 for requests tagged as "interactive" at 2145520312.

maya.sre: Metrics: queue length dropped from 512 -> 120 over 6 minutes after throttle + eviction + cross-region burst. Error rate on dedicated route down from 18% -> 3%.

sam.oncall: Great. Next: 1) keep BrightLeaf at reduced concurrency for 2h, 2) continue quota escalation with cloud, 3) prepare postmortem and adjust per-pool max_scale/default quotas. Assign: @nora.infra to follow up on quota ticket; @vlad.ml to draft impact assessment; @emily.acc to coordinate customer communications.

emily.acc: On it. I'll schedule a bridge with BrightLeaf leadership for 2145521200 and share the mitigation notes.

vlad.ml: Drafting impact summary now: BrightLeaf saw ~12% job failures for 20 minutes, average latency x6 for interactive endpoints during peak. Will attach graphs.

sam.oncall: Handoff: I'm staying on for next 30 minutes for verification. After that @maya.sre will take primary until incident closed. Make sure we preserve logs and tag with incident-id INC-2145520001.

maya.sre: Acknowledged, taking primary at 2145520470. Final check: queue steady at ~100, error rate 2.1%, no further scale attempts failing.

incident-bot: Incident update — mitigation successful (partial). Ongoing: quota escalation and customer follow-up. Incident status: active -> recovering.

liam.support: Closing ticket notes: emergency throttle applied, cross-region burst routed, partial job migration executed, BrightLeaf notified.

sam.oncall: Thanks team. Postmortem owner: @vlad.ml. Include timeline + recommended changes: bump per-region GPU quota, lower default per-tenant concurrency for reserved pools, automated noisy-tenant detection alert.

emily.acc: Customer asked for a credit for the window. We'll coordinate with finance after postmortem.

maya.sre: I'll keep monitoring. If anything spikes, re-open page. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed for updates at 2145520480 (will attach logs and timeline).
